risk_method.flood_component: Monthly historical percentile of modelled river discharge; unavailable when the location has no usable flow variation.
risk_method.rainfall_component: Monthly historical percentile of 3-day cumulative rainfall.
risk_method.weather_component: Maximum of monthly historical percentiles for daily maximum temperature and wind speed.
risk_method.fallback: Unavailable components are omitted and the remaining weights are rescaled; the ranking basis identifies this explicitly.
risk_method.interpretation: Screening index, not a calibrated probability or official warning.
